items.question: Is everything really free?
items.answer: Yes. All services at Sai Aarogya Hospital are offered completely free of charge to every individual, without discrimination based on caste, creed, religion, or economic status.

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: No appointment is needed. Walk in during OPD hours (Mon–Sat, 9 AM – 4 PM) and register at the hospital desk. To see a visiting specialist, please call us first to check their day.

items.question: Is there emergency care?
items.answer: For urgent help, call the hospital desk on +91 84999 91259. In a life-threatening emergency, call 108 for an ambulance.

items.question: Are medicines free?
items.answer: Yes. Consultations, treatment and the medicines prescribed at the hospital are provided free of charge.

items.question: Can I bring an attendant?
items.answer: Yes. One family member or attendant may accompany each patient.

items.question: How can donors outside India contribute?
items.answer: Foreign nationals who wish to contribute can write to info@saisujalasravanthi.in.

items.question: Are donations tax-exempt?
items.answer: For tax-exemption details, please write to info@saisujalasravanthi.in and the Trust will share the applicable information.

items.question: Will I receive a receipt for my donation?
items.answer: Yes. Write to info@saisujalasravanthi.in with your donation details and the Trust will send you a receipt.
